entities.name: Pierre -Claver Akendengué

entities.summary: Pierre-Claver Akendengué is a Gabonese musician and composer. In 1997, he received his country's "Prix d'excellence" at the Africa Music awards in Libreville, honoring his body of work. He also serves as a cultural advisor for the government of Gabon.
